diagnosis.summary: The nightly run for 2026-10-01 (c0b49513) failed at ingest because upstream renamed customers.csv column `country` to `country_code`. The values are still ISO-2 codes like US, the same format already stored in raw.customers.country. I've proposed an ingest column mapping country_code -> country. It hasn't been applied yet; the harness will apply it and rerun the pipeline. The other three landing files for that day match the contract.

root_cause.explanation: Upstream customers export for 2026-10-01 delivers header country_code instead of contract column country. Ingest's header-vs-contract check failed with one missing and one unexpected column, which the runbook classifies as a rename. The values are unchanged in meaning: they are ISO-2 codes, as in the history.

evidence.claim: Run c0b49513 failed at ingest with a schema mismatch on raw.customers: missing ['country'], unexpected ['country_code']
The landing file header has country_code in place of contract column country; 30 rows, no parse problems
Historical country values are ISO-2 codes (US, DE, AU, GB, CA), matching the new country_code values (US), so the meaning is unchanged
Runbook: one missing plus one unexpected column means a rename, and a rename with the same meaning is fixed with apply_column_mapping
The other landing files for this day match the contract and have no parse problems

alternatives_considered: Country column dropped with a new unrelated column added: ruled out because the values in country_code are the same ISO-2 codes as historical country values
Semantic change (e.g., full names to codes) needing escalation: ruled out because history is already ISO-2 codes
One-off delivery problem needing redelivery: unlikely because the rename looks deliberate and the file is otherwise well-formed
Other tables also broken: ruled out because the orders, order_items and payments files match the contract

proposal.rationale: Upstream renamed customers.country to country_code (one missing + one unexpected column = rename per runbook). Values are ISO-2 codes (US, ...) identical in format/meaning to historical raw.customers.country values (US, DE, AU, GB, CA), so mapping at ingest is safe. Other 2026-10-01 landing files match contract.

applied: ingest now reads raw.customers.country from upstream column 'country_code'
